messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@sysmed.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-02T09:15:00Z
Subject: Intro demo and integration checklist

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the intro via LinkedIn — were excited to learn more about Redwood. We'd like a 45-60 minute demo focused on:
- Integration requirements for a PHI-sensitive pipeline
- Expected latency and cost on dedicated capacity
- Observability and audit log primitives for compliance

Were mostly available the week of Dec 13 (morning PT) or early Jan. Can you confirm a time? Also, do you have a short checklist for pre-demo access?

Attachments: prospect_qs.xlsx (mentioned)

Best,
Julia Park
Director of Engineering, SysMed
Julia.Park@sysmed.com
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Julia Park <julia@sysmed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-03T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro demo and integration checklist

Hi Julia 

Appreciate the context — happy to run the demo. Tentatively booked you for 45 minutes on Tue Dec 14 at 10:00 AM PT. Ive attached a short demo_agenda.md that covers what well walk through and a quick pre-demo checklist (accounts + sample payloads).

Quick note: our engineering org has a company-wide operations freeze the week of Dec 20-24 for year-end (limited on-call only) and a subset of SEs are traveling for KubeCon the week prior. If anything shifts on our side Ill flag it immediately, but for now Tue Dec 14 should be fine.

Can you confirm that slot works? If not, we can propose a couple alternatives in the first week of Jan.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: demo_agenda.md

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-07T11:30:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Intro demo and integration checklist — SE coverage question

Sean / Grace,

Forwarding Julias note and our tentative Dec 14 slot. Heads up: Im out traveling Dec 13-16 (KubeCon), and our primary SE (Anya) will be in EMEA for vendor meetings the same week. Between the company freeze and travel, we risk under-resourcing the demo if we keep the current slot.

Options I see:
1) Move the customer to Dec 9-10 (earlier) — wed need GC to confirm availability on short notice.
2) Keep Dec 14 but have a product PM cover the infrastructure portion and schedule follow-up with SE in Jan for deep integration.
3) Postpone to Jan (Jan 4-8) when everyone is back and we can run a full walkthrough.

My preference is #3 for quality, but Im aware customers want momentum now. Sean, if youre okay we can propose 2 alternative windows to Julia: Dec 9 morning PT or Jan 5-6 morning PT. Ill also draft a short playbook to help the PM cover the basic infra Qs if we need to hold the original slot.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Julia Park <julia@sysmed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-09T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro demo and integration checklist

Hi Julia,

Quick update on our side  thanks for the flexibility. Due to overlapping travel and our short year-end operations freeze, a couple of our SEs who would run the deep integration portion will be unavailable the week of Dec 13. We want to make sure you get a full, technical walkthrough rather than a high-level overview.

Would either of these options work for you?
- Option A: Thu Dec 9 at 9:30 AM PT (short notice; 45 min) — SE availability limited but we can cover the core integration checklist.
- Option B: Tue Jan 5 at 10:00 AM PT (recommended) — full team (SE + PM) present for an end-to-end walkthrough.

If youd like to keep the original Dec 14 date, we can do that and have a PM cover infra + follow up with an SE session in Jan, but wed prefer Option B for continuity. Ive attached an updated playbook (redwood_playbook_v2.pdf) that the PM can use if we go forward on Dec 14.

You can pick a time quickly via our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-se/demo-60 or I can post preferred slots and let you choose. HubSpot deal: HS-45218 (for internal tracking).

Thanks again for bearing with our holiday travel schedule  we want to make sure the demo is worth your time.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Attachments: redwood_playbook_v2.pdf
